description:
## Problem
`benchbox run` and the other commands that generate data or execute queries take no host lock, so a benchmark started by hand or by an agent can overlap a test session or UAT sweep. Turning it on unconditionally would change behavior for every PyPI user and serialize legitimate parallel cloud runs.

## Change
1. Opt-in setting read only from the user's home config file (`~/.benchbox/config.yaml` resolved from `$HOME`, not `./benchbox.yaml`; loader at `benchbox/cli/config.py:145-151`) plus env override `BENCHBOX_HOST_LOCK=1|0`. Default off. Because it is `$HOME`-scoped, isolated test HOMEs never enable it.
2. When enabled, these commands take the lock with admission and watchdog for their lifetime: `run` (not `--dry-run`), `run-official`, `datagen`, `convert`, `compare` when it executes queries, `compare-dataframes`. Read-only and help commands never acquire.
3. Children and in-process re-entry follow lock-core rules, so a `benchbox run` launched by a locked pytest or UAT session never waits on its parent.
4. Windows: lock-core path fallback and non-macOS sampler.
5. User docs: the setting, env override, wait/bypass variables, watchdog modes, on the existing CLI or operations page; `changelog.d/` fragment.

## Decision gates
- D1 (resolved): opt-in, default off.
- D2 (resolved): when enabled, cloud-platform runs also lock (data generation is local).
- G1 (stop condition): if `compare` cannot tell before starting whether it will execute queries, lock the whole command and record why.

## Guardrails (all heavy-guard items)
- Linked worktree from `origin/develop` via `make worktree-create`; never the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; never `git add -A`.
- `[COMMENT-POLICY-001]`: no comments or docstrings in new code. Durations use `benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()`/`elapsed_seconds()`.
- Tests use `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR` under `tmp_path` and injected readings; never touch the real `~/.benchbox/test.lock` or depend on live host pressure, VMs or disk.
- Never delete, move or recreate a lock file from code; never stop, resize or signal processes/VMs this invocation did not start.
- Keep names `test.lock`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_SESSION_OWNER` (rename deferred on heavy-guard-status-policy).
- No automatic skip on `CI` or `BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE` (agent shells export `CI=true`).
- No heavy verification runs (no benchmark sweeps above scale 0.01, no real compose stacks) unless the item names one.
- `[CHANGELOG-001]`; CLI dry runs stay lock-free and keep propagating explicit phases; adapter SDK imports stay lazy.

## Non-goals
Per-phase locking; engine-level memory limits.
